bullets.text: After this update
, SCSKiller checks every compiled game again, which can take several minutes with many games.
Official recordings
: SCSKiller's own recordings of a game version, marked "Official recording" on the game page.
DirectX 11 games compile on AMD
Engine support updates from the server
: the rules that decide what a game compiles can be fixed or extended between releases.
Riot Client
: its games are found (VALORANT, League of Legends, Legends of Runeterra, 2XKO).
Naughty Dog games
(The Last of Us Part I, UNCHARTED 4: A Thief's End, UNCHARTED: The Lost Legacy): SCSKiller reads their shaders.
God of War Ragnarök
compiles without a recording on NVIDIA.
Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT
and
Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
compile without a recording on NVIDIA, and after a recording on AMD.
Horizon Zero Dawn Complete Edition
and
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
: SCSKiller reads their shaders.
Overwatch (Steam)
compiles its DirectX 11 shaders without a recording (on AMD, the pixel and compute shaders).
Source 2 games
like Counter-Strike 2 compile their DirectX 11 shaders without a recording (on AMD, all but the vertex shaders).
Notifications
under a bell at the top: news, notes on new rules and links, only ones SCSKiller signed.
"What's new"
lists a version's changes once after an update.
Max compile
on a game's page compiles every combination of that game's shaders, once.
Maximum mode suggested per game
: a game whose Maximum mode is known to help on your GPU says so on its page, with "Turn on for this game".
AMD cache use
: Settings and the Cache page show the DirectX 12 cache against the driver's fixed 16 GB, and say when it's nearly full.
Cache page
: every shader cache on the PC with its size, by installed game, uninstalled game, old driver, earlier SCSKiller compiles and other GPU vendor, and the folder the driver reads and writes it in.
A game marked not supported after it was compiled offers to clear the cache compiled for it.

A driver cache folder moved to another drive with a junction is followed: Settings shows that drive's free space, and a link whose drive is missing holds compiles instead of marking games as cleared by the driver.
Library sorting and filters
: the Game, Pipelines and Cache headers sort each section, and a status filter shows only games that aren't supported, are ready to compile, are compiled, or were compiled by SCSKiller.
Game folders
: add a folder of games no store lists, and SCSKiller finds each game in it at every scan.
Scan progress
shows per store and per game, and a big library shows its last list at once while the scan runs.
New shaders compile on their own
if you choose: when a compiled game gains pipelines from its recording, the community database or an update, SCSKiller compiles them while the PC is idle, never while you play.
Theme
: Light, Dark or the Windows setting, in Settings.
A click on the tray icon
opens a small window with SCSKiller's status and the compile's progress, and Pause, Open and Quit.
"Share diagnostics to help fix problems"
in Settings (off by default): when a compile fails or the driver rejects pipelines, SCSKiller sends error codes and pipeline hashes, nothing else.
Shader hash sharing
also sends one report after a compile: which pipelines still compiled at the next launch, with your GPU model and driver.
Compile progress on the game page
: while a game compiles, its page shows the queue's progress and the time left.
Edit the compile queue in bulk
: select several games with Ctrl+click or Shift+click, then Remove selected.
Pick the DirectX
of a game when SCSKiller only guessed it: Auto, DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 next to its engine on the game page.
GPU picker
in Settings, on a PC with more than one NVIDIA or AMD GPU: SCSKiller compiles for the one you pick instead of the one with the most video memory.
Earlier sessions
on a game's page: the last 20 launches with frame times, each with its date, play length, 1% low and stutters.
Send report
: once a game was compiled and played, or couldn't be compiled, its page can send an anonymous report of how it ran.
A new community recording
for a game you compiled rebuilds its plan while the PC is idle, and the game shows how many more pipelines it can compile.
A game whose engine SCSKiller reads better says "SCSKiller can compile more" instead of "Game shaders changed".
When new rules more than double a game's plan, the compile after a driver update leaves it for you to start.
A recompile compiles only what isn't compiled yet
, so adding a recording or turning on Maximum mode is quicker.
On NVIDIA, a game no longer asks to compile again after each session for pipelines whose shaders its last compile already compiled.
On NVIDIA, compiled ray tracing pipelines that a game creates on other threads (The Witcher 3) are found in the cache at launch instead of compiling again.
The Library holds still: a game that changes is updated in its row, the list keeps its place when a game moves to another section, and the scan's status line no longer pushes the list down.
Less memory with big community recordings
: a download is checked as it decodes and kept compressed, and a compile no longer holds every recorded shader in memory.
Bigger community recordings on NVIDIA
: up to 500,000 pipelines per game, once the community database serves them.
Building a plan can no longer run forever or take all the memory.
A plan that outgrows half the PC's RAM or 30 minutes stops with a clear error, and the next compile plans again.
With "Closes to System Tray" on, closing the window no longer sometimes quits SCSKiller.
Updates
: after a failed download, SCSKiller waits longer before the next try (1 hour, then up to 12).
A
partly compiled
game's "Last compile" card says what the refused pipelines mean and what helps, and the coverage ring of a compiled game no longer counts the pipelines the driver refused.
While a compile runs, the queue and the game page say "memory limit: 4 of 32 threads" when the compile's memory limit runs fewer threads than set.
Pipelines that crash the GPU driver
are all found and skipped in one compile (The Witcher 3 on AMD).
Pipelines that make the GPU driver fault
(PRAGMATA on AMD) are found and skipped the same way.
The "Last compile" card says "Nothing failed." also when it skipped pipelines whose shaders aren't in this version of the game.
Start with Windows
: a portable or test copy of SCSKiller no longer removes the installed copy's autostart, or moves it to itself, when it starts.
NVIDIA Auto Shader Compilation
in Settings: Apply changes only what differs.
app.log
in SCSKiller's data folder keeps what the app did (scans, community sync, compiles and the recorder) for a bug report.
GTA V Enhanced
compiles on NVIDIA without a recording.
Resident Evil Village
and
PRAGMATA
compile on NVIDIA without a recording.
Dragon's Dogma 2
: SCSKiller reads its game files, which it refused before.
Games that build all their shaders at the main menu
(Horizon Forbidden West, Detroit: Become Human) show as not supported, with that reason.
Encrypted Unreal games with anti-cheat
(VALORANT and others) get their key from the exe file on disk, so SCSKiller can read their files.
Encrypted Unreal games

take their correct AES key where it was refused or opened only some files: games with their own decryption (Dead by Daylight and other forks), files under a named key, and readable file lists whose files are encrypted.
Cyberpunk 2077
shows its engine as REDengine 4, and Alan Wake 2 and CONTROL Resonant as Northlight 2.
Cyberpunk 2077 on Steam
is found with its own exe, the one its launcher configuration names, not REDprelauncher.exe.
Returnal
no longer compiles tessellated pipelines the driver rejects.

Games whose shaders carry their own root signatures (Naughty Dog, RAGE, FromSoftware and others SCSKiller reads directly) no longer compile pipelines the driver rejects, where a shader uses resources the root signature lacks.
The Last of Us Part I
: a compute shader the game ships with several root signatures compiles once for each of them, instead of only the first.
War Thunder
is on the known shader-stutter list, and no longer stays on "Needs rebuilding" when nothing new comes of it.
ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
with its Digital Artbook & Mini Soundtrack installed no longer shows as a DirectX 11 Unity game.
Unreal Engine 4.25 games no longer show "not tested on this engine version yet".
Unreal versions
: 5.7 and 5.8 games no longer show as 5.6, and a game on a newer Unreal than SCSKiller knows says "Unreal 5.9 isn't supported yet" instead of compiling as 5.8.
DirectX 11 shaders that read a multisampled texture with more samples than the GPU supports compile.
Games started through EasyAntiCheat's bootstrap
(Gears of War: E-Day and Sea of Thieves from the Xbox app) compile for the game's own exe, the one the anti-cheat's settings name, instead of the bootstrap.
A game's page says the game may still run its own shader step when it starts.
A not supported game no longer shows its shader coverage after Clear cache.
ReShade and HDR mods
like RenoDX show as a tag in the Library and on the game page, and "Compiles through RenoDX" under the game's status.
Luma mods no longer make the game page say some pipelines aren't precompiled (they change no DirectX 12 pipeline).
When a mod loads a copy of the recorder from another folder, where it can't record, the game page says so.
ReShade chaining another mod
through ReShade.ini's
[PROXY] ProxyLibrary
(OptiScaler or a DLSS mod under another name) no longer compiles through a copy of ReShade that lacks that mod's DLL.
Recording in games with anti-cheat, at your own risk.
Until now the recorder always stayed out of these games, so they never got a recording of their own.
Frame times with frame generation on
(FSR 3): the graph shows the frames the game rendered.
Frame times in games with NVIDIA Streamline
(Ghost of Tsushima, Ratchet & Clank) on every GPU.
On NVIDIA, the recorder no longer makes a game crash as it closes.
The recorder no longer crashes a game now and then as it sets up its hooks.
It moved a few of a function's first instructions to make room for its jump, so a game thread paused among them could resume mid-jump and crash.
A game that makes its own crash dump or log folder
(Horizon Zero Dawn's coredumps) no longer turns the recorder off.
A portable or test copy
keeps its own recorders: each copy's armed list is in its own data folder, and a copy never arms, updates, removes or imports the recording of a recorder another copy placed.
The recorder's log no longer holds your user name or full folder paths, so it's safer to share in a bug report.
Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC) games
never get the recorder.
NetEase games whose anti-cheat leaves no file in the game folder

count as anti-cheat games, so the recorder stays out of them: the Steam installs of Once Human, Marvel Rivals, FragPunk, Sword of Justice and NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, and Once Human from any store by its exe.
ELDEN RING added by hand
gets the offline session too, when the EasyAntiCheat settings beside its exe are ELDEN RING's.
Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator
count as anti-cheat games on a PC with TruckersMP.
Xbox app Unreal games that start through a small launcher
(Senua's Saga: Hellblade II, Avowed) record.
A Steam game you uninstalled loses the recorder too.
Steam leaves the folder behind when it holds files it didn't install.
Initial experimental Linux support.
Command line
add
adds a game no store lists.
Leave out of Add all ready
on the game page: the game stays out of Add all ready, and its own Add button still works.
Remove from library
on every game's page.
Set AES key
on the game page of an encrypted Unreal game: paste your own key there, without opening Why? first.
DirectX choice
on the game page of every DirectX game, also where SCSKiller is sure which one it runs on.
Before and after recording

on the game page of a recorded DirectX 12 or DirectX 11 game: SCSKiller deletes the game's shader caches and starts it, you play 5 minutes, it deletes the caches again and compiles, and you play the same 5 minutes again.
Intel GPUs (experimental, contributed by nyannoying1337)
: Settings shows "Experimental: compile on Intel GPUs" on a PC with an Intel GPU, off by default.
Send report
lists what a report carries until you've sent one.
Compile ray tracing shaders
in Settings, on by default, with a choice per game on its page.
Also delete the game's own shader cache
also clears the pipeline libraries of GTA V Enhanced and HELLDIVERS 2.
Also delete the game's own shader cache
no longer deletes an Unreal game's user pipeline cache.
The game scan keeps going past a file it can't read
, on a failing drive or in a cloud folder.
On NVIDIA, a compile where several shaders hang the driver at once skips them for that compile and keeps going.
A compile that created nothing ends as Failed and says why, such as the driver rejecting every pipeline, instead of Done with a count.
On Windows 10, a game whose exe is protected or packed, such as AION 2 and Fortnite, compiles with the game's own D3D12 runtime from its D3D12 folder.
On NVIDIA, a game whose compiled shader cache files are gone, or smaller than after its compile, asks to compile again.
On AMD, a game whose files the driver removed because its shader cache is full no longer asks to compile again, which only removed another game's files in turn.
Keep compiled caches aside
(AMD, Settings): a compiled game's shader cache is put back after the driver's 16 GB limit removes it, so it doesn't stutter again.
On NVIDIA, a plan built again after a new recording no longer offers to compile the shaders the last compile already compiled.
The coverage ring
on the game page is one measure in every state, so it no longer drops after each play, jumps when the game needs compiling again, or rises when the driver refuses more than a tenth of the pipelines.
A compile run by another SCSKiller, such as a portable copy, no longer counts as playing the game.
A portable copy made from your installed SCSKiller's data folder starts with Start with Windows, Record all games and automatic updates off.
A community recording that doesn't match the game's files
is no longer compiled, which skipped all its pipelines every time, and games whose shaders SCSKiller can't read no longer share or download recordings under one hash.
A game compiles one texture filtering setting unless Maximum mode is on, so a community recording with several settings no longer makes its compile several times bigger.
On Unreal games, the texture filtering setting compiled is the player's own when the game's settings files name it.
After an app update, a compiled game stays compiled until its plan is checked, and says it can compile more only when the check finds more.
Unreal games
also compile what the game saved in its own pipeline cache in your user folder while you played, without the recorder, also when the game contains anti-cheat.
Reading shaders
on Unreal games runs at below-normal priority and shows how many packages it has read, so games like Days Gone or Styx no longer look stuck there and the window stays responsive.
A ray tracing shader that crashes or hangs the driver is skipped for that compile, along with the ones built on it, and the compile keeps all its threads.
A compile stopped after the driver reset too many times continues from where it stopped.
DirectX 11 games
: shaders SCSKiller can't compile yet count as skipped, no longer as refused by the driver, and Unity games such as Megabonk compile more of their shaders.
When a compile pauses for a game, the shaders it was building are finished on resume instead of being skipped and blamed on the driver.
Updates never install a version older than the one running
, unless you pick Go back to stable.
On AMD, a game that gives the driver its own name through AMD's AGS library gets its compile where it reads its shaders, once the recorder saw it play.
The game page says Careful compile is only for games whose compile fails.
On NVIDIA, the game page also says a compile didn't help when that shows after a Before and after run or after Clear cache.
While a game runs, its page shows the last finished play under Last time you played, not part of the current one.
A game that compiled shaders for its whole launch no longer shows "no stutters" and a 1% low of 0 fps on its page.
On AMD, Before and after and Clear cache no longer delete the DirectX 11 shader cache of another game with the same exe name.
RE Engine games
with an empty patch file in their folder (Resident Evil 2, often a mod manager's leftover) no longer show "Not supported yet".
Games whose ray tracing is all inline, such as RE Engine games, count their shaders that trace rays inline in the game page details.
Hidden game folders are scanned
, such as a Unity game's Data folder hidden in Explorer.
DCS World
and other games with two builds of one program (bin\DCS.exe and bin-mt\DCS.exe) can be added with their own folder, which was refused as "a folder of several games" (found by JLAF5150).
Xbox app Unreal games
built for WinGDK (Evil West) read their own DirectX setting, not the Windows one.
FINAL FANTASY XV WINDOWS EDITION
precompiles every DirectX 11 shader without a recording (on AMD, all but the vertex shaders).
Mass Effect Legendary Edition
FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles
and
KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX
on Steam list each of their games on its own.
Forza Horizon 6
(Steam and Xbox app) compiles from its game files without a recording.
Unreal games stay detected
when SCSKiller can't download a decompression codec, such as behind a proxy, firewall or antivirus.
A game that needs a recording and is in the community database says "in the community database for Patreon supporters" when you aren't signed in as one, since only they can compile from it.
PRAGMATA
gets no recorder for now, since it crashes the game while it loads.
WARDOGS
counts as a game with anti-cheat (Elytra), so the recorder goes in only through "Record a session (at your own risk)".
THE FINALS
counts as a game with anti-cheat by its Steam id, since Elytra installs outside its folder.
A Steam game whose launch options start an anti-cheat launcher
counts as a game with anti-cheat even when no anti-cheat file is in its folder yet.
A mod the recorder ran alongside
no longer comes back after its own uninstall removed it.
A portable copy upgraded from 1.2.5 takes back the recorders it placed, so they record and update again.
A portable copy made from your installed SCSKiller's data folder
no longer takes over the recorders the installed copy placed.
Frame times are recorded again in games where a mod such as ReShade replaces DirectX's dxgi.dll
, so the game page's frame-time graph and the Before and after panel show there.
The recorder records while the game's exe is the one SCSKiller last checked for anti-cheat, and no anti-cheat is next to it or in the game's folders above it.
Forza Horizon 6
contains anti-cheat.
A VAC game in a folder whose path is longer than 260 characters
counts as VAC, so the recorder stays out.
A portable copy made from another 1.2.5 portable copy's data folder takes over that copy's recorders.
HDD mode
in Settings: SCSKiller reads a game's files only when you open or compile it, so scans finish on big or slow libraries.
Maximum memory for compiling
goes up to 2 GB below your PC's RAM.
Compile queue
and Start no longer add games you didn't pick.
Games show in the library as soon as a scan finds them, and a game you add shows at once.
Compiles no longer stay slow after hitting the memory limit
on ray tracing games.
Games with many driver-crashing pipelines can start their compile again.
A compile no longer stops when the GPU driver crashes the compile process outright.
It goes on and skips only the pipeline that crashed.
A compile downloads the community upscaler packs for that game first, so it no longer shows "Needs rebuilding" right after compiling.
Games with too many shaders to plan compile their recorded pipelines instead of failing, and their status says "recorded pipelines only".
A compiled game only shows "Needs rebuilding" once at least 500 new pipelines are recorded
, or 1% of its plan if that is more.
Unreal games keep their game exe
when another program from the game's folder runs during play, so a compile no longer goes to the wrong exe and the game no longer asks for a full rebuild after playing.
One unreadable Steam game folder no longer hides every Steam game.
A game no longer counts as running when another program with the same exe name runs, such as Office's ai.exe for Alien: Isolation.
When NVIDIA Auto Shader Compilation can't be applied, the error says why NVIDIA's tool failed, and the app log keeps its full output.
Before and after
warns up front that the game's own shader cache is deleted, isn't backed up and can take minutes to rebuild.
The Before and after report says that 1% low and average count from the game's first frame, menus and loading screens included.
ELDEN RING
with its DLC installed compiles even when the DLC's key can't be found, and the DLC's shaders are added once the key downloads.
EA SPORTS WRC
from the EA app is compiled for WRC.exe instead of the leftover trial exe.
Godot games
show Vulkan or OpenGL instead of DirectX 11 and 12, and are marked as not supported.
Unity games now show the DirectX of their latest run, so "Record while I play" comes back after a game switches to DirectX 12.
Games whose shared recording includes players without mesh shader support, like
SILENT HILL: Townfall
, now get their full compile again instead of about a third of it.
Assassin's Creed Shadows, Mirage and Black Flag Resynced
get no recorder for now, since they failed to start with it.
Frame times and Before and after work in games where ReShade is installed as d3d12.dll or d3d11.dll
(ReShade 6.8 or later).
Turning recording off keeps the last session's graph on the game page.
Turning recording off also removes the recorder copy Onimusha keeps in its _storage_ folder.
